description: Immediately revoke a private push monitor token. Future submissions to its HTTP endpoint are rejected. Requires its monitor ID and monitor token. Example: invoke monitor_revoke with the required arguments shown in its input schema; use the workspace or resource credentials issued by Zorqelio, never placeholder credentials in production.

monitorToken.description: Secret token issued for this monitor.

operationId.description: Stable unique request identifier. Reuse it only for an exact retry.

name: monitor_revoke
